name: fabioaacarneiro/sfphp-framework
description: A full-stack PHP framework with zero runtime dependencies, complete async/await system using PHP Fibers, reactive components, and real-time capabilities.

scripts.lint: find app src public tests tools resources -type f -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l && php -l server.php && php -l sfphp

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: The PDO driver for MySQL 8+ — install the one for the database you use.
suggest.ext-redis: The Redis cache, session and queue drivers, and anything shared between instances. Not bundled with PHP (PECL).
suggest.ext-pcntl: Graceful stop on SIGTERM and per-job timeouts for the queue worker. Unix only, which is why it is not required.
suggest.ext-posix: Terminal detection for coloured dump() output in the console.
suggest.ext-gd: Generates the PWA icons in make:pwa.
suggest.ext-intl: Locale-correct dates and numbers (CLDR). Without it they fall back to ISO dates and separators guessed from the language.
